items.headline: TIAA gets sign permit at 2875 El Camino Real
items.summary: Three illuminated wall signs for TIAA were approved for the building at 2875 El Camino Real.

items.headline: Massage Envy signage permit issued on El Camino Real
items.summary: A permit for two new illuminated LED channel letter wall signs for Massage Envy was approved at 2515 El Camino Real, signaling the business's storefront identification there.

items.headline: Campbell, San Jose to split cost of resurfacing project
items.summary: The council approved a cost-share agreement with the City of San Jose, capped at $335,000, to fund resurfacing work shared between the two cities.

items.headline: Council to review State Route 17 congestion relief plans
items.summary: Los Gatos Town Council is set to hold a study session on the State Route 17 Corridor Congestion Relief Project, a topic of ongoing concern for South Bay commuters dealing with traffic on the highway.
